normalization.normalCleanup: Only disconnected exterior alpha pixels with maximum alpha2 were removed, then full-canvas uniform resampling; all retained raw RGBA unchanged before resampling.
normalization.pixelCommonRule: Transparent central padding to raw maximum edge, uniform nearest-neighbor resize to128 square, global palette nearest RGB mapping, binary alpha threshold128, whole-canvas support registration only.
normalization.pixel05RegistrationEvidence: After common Y-2, left rear and center front planted supports were both+2px from rounded same-normal projection; swing was also+2px. Additional whole-canvasY-2 made supports92/101 and swing90. No scale change, no clipping, all visible RGBA preserved.
normalization.existingSquarePadRuleProof: For existing1254-square raw frames, central max-edge padding is a no-op and the resulting128 RGBA resampling is unchanged. Existing adopted PNG files were not overwritten.
normalization.pixelPaletteMethod: Phase01 global30-color MEDIANCUT plus actual light/dark source colors, at most32 visible colors; every subsequent frame uses this same palette with nearest squared RGB distance, no dithering.
normalization.footAnchorNote: Each foot has a separate projected support depth. The global bottom is not used to align normals because it may belong to the swinging center-front foot.

qa.individualFrames: Independent limited visual and technical frame/pair checks passed with residual caveats.
qa.sequenceReview: Ordered static normal and native128 pixel sequences01-02-03-04-05-06-01 were independently inspected by integration reviewer and coordinator. Center-front, viewer-left rear and viewer-right rear recovery alternate with three-foot contact. The06-to01 closure retains rear supports while recovering center front. No different creature, missing foot, or pronounced body-size change was seen.
residualCaveats: Pixel02/04/06 have darker tone and weaker eye highlights than recovery phases; fixed palette does not eliminate color-area and speckle variation.
Pixel03 crown is roughly1-2px higher than early phases. Pixel05 width is104px versus106px in other adopted generated pixel frames, and crown is29px versus26-28px elsewhere.
Normal01 central recovery is about27px rather than the initial12px guide. Normal03/05 rear-foot recovery is about18px. Production guide values are not exact reproduced amplitudes.
Normal surface fine-line detail varies, and the exposed volume of the central foot shortens when recovered.
Some connected low-alpha colored fringes remain from raw generation; no local repaint or shape erasure was applied.
Reuse normal02/04/06 has original material detail rather than generated-phase surface detail.
Limited ordered-still approval does not establish continuous-playback smoothness, all-eight-direction completion, or game/device acceptance.
qa.preservationNote: All originals, raw outputs, superseded candidates and failed export diagnostics are retained separately; only accepted source files were copied into this set.
